args.reason: Persist git integration points discussed for the lighter Restate + Tekton + Argo CD factory stack.

facts.v: Git is the desired-state bus for the lighter Restate factory stack: agent writes, Argo CD syncs, Tekton clones; loop state stays in Restate.
Restate activities commit or open PRs of desired manifests (or DeploymentRequest descriptors) into the GitOps repo; agents do not kubectl-apply.
Argo CD watches the GitOps repo, syncs, and exposes sync/health status; Restate waits on that status.
Tekton PipelineRuns clone the app/repo for build and test; optionally push images/tags or status commits back as CI artifact flow.
Factory loop progress, retries, and agent session state live in Restate, not in git commits.
Desired-state bus: write path agent→git, apply path Argo CD←git, build path Tekton←git.
Prefer Restate over Temporal when a lighter in-process durable runtime is enough.
